resource_risks.description: The new command starts a CLI adapter subprocess for one subagent tool execution.
resource_risks.mitigation: The command reuses create_cli_session, SessionStore, cancel_cli_adapter_session, and cleanup_finished_sessions_locked instead of adding a new runner or daemon.

resource_risks.description: Executing every planned subagent tool could create uncontrolled parallel CLI processes.
resource_risks.mitigation: The UI and command execute only one selected tool from a saved plan; fan-out and merge are explicitly out of scope.

resource_risks.description: A subagent execution prompt could ask the guest CLI to inspect local-only private folders.
resource_risks.mitigation: The generated prompt includes explicit manager-owned boundaries and forbids _private and outputs access.
